prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A moody, cinematic scene set in a dimly lit, blue-toned environment. In the foreground, a vintage CRT television screen displays a grainy black-and-white broadcast, featuring a man in a suit standing beside a weather report with bold, blocky text and numbers. The most prominent element is a hand, partially illuminated by the cool blue light, reaching out and almost touching the TV screen, creating a sense of longing or connection. The hand is clad in a white or light-colored sleeve, contrasting sharply with the deep shadows and the blue ambient lighting that dominates the scene. The background is dark and out of focus, emphasizing the glowing TV and the gesture of the hand. The overall composition uses a shallow depth of field, drawing attention to the interaction between the hand and the screen, while the rest of the space fades into darkness. The mood is introspective and mysterious, with a retro-futuristic aesthetic reminiscent of neo-noir films.
